integrity: The source provides the original RCR rate formula; the new result optimizes its discrete reuse parameter. No independent review claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the fixed-memory RCR source regime q=m+1 with matched initialization, exact arithmetic, generic full support, constant positive integer reuse, asymptotic per-actual-update rate. Does not measure finite-tolerance efficiency or extrapolate to SCR and full spectral dimension.
title: Five is the unique update-optimal reuse count in rolling cyclic Ritz descent
